name: load_heatmap
title: Network Load Heatmap
description: Visualizes average load across the network edges.
author: Antigravity

requirements.description: This plugin generates a network-wide load heatmap (average power flow) on edges.
agent_directives: Use this plugin when the user asks for 'load heatmap', 'congested lines', or 'system-wide loading'.
This plugin colors the map edges based on average loading. It does not open a window.
